stories.headline: World Bank approves $300 million to improve Bangladesh's primary education
stories.summary: The World Bank's Board approved $300 million on 6 November to improve learning for 26 million children from pre-primary to grade 5 in Bangladesh. The Learning Enhancement and Acceleration in Primary Education Program will support the government's Fifth Primary Education Development Program, focusing on reading, writing and mathematics. The IDA financing has a 25-year term, including a five-year grace period.
stories.why_it_matters: Primary education quality is a core BCS/Bank topic: it links public spending, human capital and Bangladesh's development goals, and the figures are directly askable.
stories.exam_facts: Programme: Learning Enhancement and Acceleration in Primary Education (LEAP); supports PEDP-5; funder: International Development Association (IDA); $300 million; 26 million children; 25-year term, five-year grace.
stories.exam_relevance: High — World Bank, education financing, PEDP.
stories.key_people: Jean Pesme, World Bank Division Director for Bangladesh and Bhutan.
stories.figures: $300 million; 26 million children (pre-primary to grade 5); 25-year term, five-year grace period.

stories.headline: Why has growth of transactions through Bangla QR stalled?
stories.summary: Bangladesh Bank's Bangla QR initiative, launched to cut cash use, has stalled. Daily transactions were Tk 2-3 billion in the last two weeks of May, rose to Tk 13.5 billion in the first week of October, then fell to Tk 11.9 billion by the last week of October. Bangladesh Bank has set targets for banks, and peer-to-peer Bangla QR payments began this month, but industry insiders see no immediate growth without new initiatives.
stories.why_it_matters: Digital payments and Bangladesh Bank policy are recurring BCS/Bank topics; the figures show how to read a trend, not just a headline.
stories.exam_facts: Bangla QR is Bangladesh Bank's interoperable QR payment system for reducing cash use; peer-to-peer service began in November 2026.
stories.exam_relevance: High — banking, digital payments, Bangladesh Bank.
stories.figures: Tk 2-3 billion/day (late May); Tk 13.5 billion/day (first week of October); Tk 11.9 billion/day (last week of October).

stories.headline: Rabindranath Tagore's mural defaced in Bangladesh
stories.summary: A mural of Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore on the boundary wall of Khulna Railway Station was defaced with black ink by unidentified persons, local media reported on 7 November. Murals of Lalon, S M Sultan, Kazi Nazrul Islam, Khaleda Zia, Ziaur Rahman and Michael Madhusudan Dutta on the same wall were untouched. Two anti-Tagore and anti-India posters were found beside it. Police learnt of it on Friday afternoon and are investigating.
stories.why_it_matters: Cultural heritage, law and order, and Bangladesh-India sentiment in one story; Tagore's link to the national anthem makes it exam-relevant.
stories.exam_facts: Tagore wrote 'Amar Sonar Bangla', Bangladesh's national anthem; Khulna City Corporation commissioned the murals ahead of PM Tarique Rahman's visit to Khulna; a Tagore mural was also defaced in Dhaka in October.
stories.key_people: Lokman Hossain, Officer-in-Charge, Khulna Sadar Police Station.
stories.figures: Damage noticed Friday morning, 6 November 2026; second such incident after Dhaka in October 2026.

stories.headline: 35 senior govt officials to travel to Pakistan for training
stories.summary: Thirty-five senior government officials — five additional secretaries and 30 joint secretaries — will travel to Pakistan for 14 days of training at the National School of Public Policy in Lahore, from 9 to 22 November. The Ministry of Public Administration issued the government order last Wednesday. It is the second phase: in May, 12 officials trained at the Civil Services Academy in Lahore from 4 to 21 May.
stories.why_it_matters: Civil-service training and Bangladesh-Pakistan official contact are directly relevant to BCS candidates, who are the officials of tomorrow.

stories.headline: BUET follows Dhaka University, keeps 2026-27 admission test on schedule
stories.summary: BUET has announced its undergraduate admission test for the 2026-27 session will be held on 16 January 2027, with applications expected to open on 21 November 2026. Following Dhaka University, BUET will hold the test as originally scheduled. In 2025-26 there was no preliminary screening test; candidates were selected only through a written examination. The notice does not say whether that system will continue this year.
stories.why_it_matters: Admission dates are the most practical exam information for candidates, and BUET/DU admission policy is itself a frequent GK item.

stories.headline: Kenyan starvation cult leader sentenced to 200 years for child murders
stories.summary: Self-proclaimed Kenyan pastor Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to 200 years in prison on 6 November for the murder of 190 children and one adult in the Shakahola starvation cult. He was convicted last month of murdering 191 people between January 2021 and September 2023, alongside 28 co-accused. Hundreds of bodies have been found since 2023 at the sect's base near Malindi. The court gave 100 years for homicide and 100 for starvation charges.
stories.why_it_matters: A major international justice story with precise figures — the kind of world current-affairs item BCS asks about — and a source of strong vocabulary.
stories.exam_facts: Shakahola Forest Massacre, near Malindi, Kenya; Mackenzie, a former taxi driver, told followers to starve themselves to 'meet Jesus'.
stories.key_people: Paul Mackenzie, self-proclaimed pastor; Mombasa Law Courts, Kenya.
stories.figures: 200 years (100 homicide + 100 starvation); 191 murdered (190 children, 1 adult); 28 co-accused; bodies found since 2023.

stories.headline: PM leads 7 November procession, warns conspirators of a crushing response
stories.summary: Prime Minister and BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman joined the BNP's sovereignty procession from Naya Paltan on 7 November, walking at the front towards Manik Mia Avenue to mark National Revolution and Solidarity Day. Speaking briefly outside the party's central office, he alleged conspiracies were being hatched again and warned of a 'crushing response', as on 7 November 1975, saying no conspiracy could suppress the pro-democracy people.
stories.why_it_matters: The main political event of 7 November itself — the PM's first 7 November as prime minister — and a direct quote that may be asked about.
stories.exam_facts: 7 November is observed as National Revolution and Solidarity Day, marking the 1975 civil-military uprising; the PM cited 1971, 1990 and 7 November 1975.
stories.key_people: Tarique Rahman, Prime Minister and BNP Chairman.
stories.figures: Procession began about 3:00 pm, 7 November 2026; route: Naya Paltan, past the Chief Justice's residence and InterContinental Hotel, through Banglamotor and Farmgate to Manik Mia Avenue.

stories.headline: What happened on 7 November and what I saw
stories.summary: In a first-hand account published on 7 November, retired Brigadier General M Sakhawat Hossain recalls the night of 7 November 1975, when gunfire and cries of 'Zindabad' woke his cantonment household and tanks moved south towards Tejgaon. The account, excerpted from his book Roktakto Dinguli: 1975-1981 (The Bloody Days), describes 7 November as one of the most decisive turning points in Bangladesh's political history.
stories.why_it_matters: A first-hand account of the event the day commemorates — useful background for the 7 November GK questions that recur every year.
stories.exam_facts: All facts here are the author's recollection, not independently verified news. Book: Roktakto Dinguli: 1975-1981 (The Bloody Days).

stories.headline: 'Coordinator' of attack, Juboraj, still not arrested
stories.summary: More than a month after the attack on the New Gini Properties project at ECB Chattar in Dhaka, police have yet to arrest Md Juboraj, identified by investigators as a key coordinator. Juboraj, linked to a gang led by Md Ibrahim, convenor of Bhashantek thana BNP, allegedly brought together members of two Mirpur gangs. Investigators say prime accused Shahriar Mahmud agreed to pay Ibrahim Tk 10 million (Tk 1 crore) for the attack.

stories.headline: PM announces pay rise for Gram Police, govt to pay mobile bills
stories.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced a pay rise for Gram Police at a rally at the National Parade Ground on 7 November. A member's monthly salary rises from Tk 7,500 to Tk 10,500 and a chief's from Tk 8,000 to Tk 11,000, effective today. Retirement gratuity rises to Tk 80,000 for members and Tk 1 lakh for chiefs, with a Tk 150 monthly mobile allowance, higher travel allowances, two more women members per union and six months' maternity leave.
stories.why_it_matters: Pay, allowances and service conditions of a uniformed force are classic BCS/Bank GK, and every figure here is directly askable.
stories.exam_facts: Gram Police are the village-level police force; the announcements were made at a rally marking National Revolution and Solidarity Day.
stories.exam_relevance: High — governance, pay and service rules.
stories.key_people: Tarique Rahman, Prime Minister; Zubaida Rahman, present at the rally.
stories.figures: Salary: Tk 7,500 to Tk 10,500 (members), Tk 8,000 to Tk 11,000 (chiefs); gratuity: Tk 50,000 to Tk 80,000 / Tk 80,000 to Tk 1 lakh; mobile Tk 150/month; travel Tk 500/week (chiefs Tk 600).

stories.headline: 7 Bangladeshis killed, 15 injured in road accident in Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Seven Bangladeshis, including children, were killed and 15 injured when a truck rammed into their bus from behind on the road from Medina to Jeddah in Saudi Arabia early on 7 November. The victims, members of several families, were returning from Medina. Bangladesh's Consul General in Jeddah confirmed the accident and said the consulate had formally asked Saudi authorities for details. The dead are at a local hospital morgue; the injured are being treated there.

stories.headline: Tk 800 million spent developing 12 software tools: How useful have they been?
stories.summary: The ICT Division has spent Tk 800 million developing 12 software tools, including the AI platform Kagoj.ai, launched on 15 December last year, whose OCR service converts text in images into editable Word files. But usage appears very limited: Google Lens and other free apps already offer the same OCR service and were launched long before Kagoj.ai. The report questions how useful the government's tools have been.
stories.why_it_matters: Public spending on technology and value-for-money is a favourite BCS/Bank theme, and the comparison with free alternatives is the exam point.
stories.exam_facts: Kagoj.ai offers optical character recognition (OCR); it was launched by Faiz Ahmad Taiyeb, special assistant to the chief adviser of the former interim government.
stories.key_people: Faiz Ahmad Taiyeb, special assistant to the chief adviser of the former interim government.
stories.figures: Tk 800 million (Tk 80 crore); 12 software tools; Kagoj.ai launched 15 December 2025.

But usage appears very limited: Google Lens and other free apps already offer the same OCR service and were launched long before Kagoj.ai. stories.headline: Ziaur Rahman's photo missing from banner, Sheikh Mujib called 'Father of the Nation', sparking uproar
stories.summary: An uproar broke out at a Joypurhat discussion marking National Revolution and Solidarity Day on 7 November after the banner was found to be missing a photograph of martyred President Ziaur Rahman, while Sheikh Mujibur Rahman was called 'Bangabandhu' and 'Father of the Nation'. State Minister for Public Administration and Food Abdul Bari expressed anger and ordered an investigation; the deputy commissioner apologised. The programme could not start at its scheduled 10:00 am.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how contested the history of 7 November still is — exactly the kind of nuance BCS history questions probe.
stories.exam_facts: 7 November 1975: Ziaur Rahman was freed from house arrest in the civil-military uprising; historical interpretations of the day are politically contested.
stories.key_people: Abdul Bari, State Minister for Public Administration and Food; Al-Mamun Mia, Deputy Commissioner, Joypurhat.
stories.figures: Meeting at District Shilpakala Academy auditorium, Joypurhat, 7 November 2026, scheduled 10:00 am.

mcqs.question: How much financing did the World Bank approve on 6 November 2026 for Bangladesh's primary education?
mcqs.explanation: The World Bank approved $300 million for 26 million children from pre-primary to grade 5.

mcqs.question: According to Bangladesh Bank data, what were daily Bangla QR transactions in the last week of October 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Daily transactions were Tk 2-3 billion in late May, rose to Tk 13.5 billion in the first week of October, then fell to Tk 11.9 billion in the last week of October.

mcqs.question: Whose mural on the Khulna Railway Station wall was defaced with black ink?
mcqs.explanation: Tagore's mural was defaced; the murals of the others on the same wall were untouched.

mcqs.question: How many senior government officials are going to Pakistan for training in November 2026?
mcqs.explanation: 35 officials — five additional secretaries and 30 joint secretaries — go for 14 days of training in Lahore.

mcqs.question: When will BUET hold its undergraduate admission test for the 2026-27 session?
mcqs.explanation: The test will be held on 16 January 2027; applications open on 21 November 2026.

mcqs.question: To how many years in prison was Kenyan pastor Paul Mackenzie sentenced?
mcqs.explanation: Mackenzie was sentenced to 200 years — 100 for homicide and 100 for starvation charges.

mcqs.question: From where did the BNP's 7 November 2026 procession start?
mcqs.explanation: The procession started from Naya Paltan, in front of the BNP's central office, and moved towards Manik Mia Avenue.

mcqs.question: How much money was allegedly agreed to be paid to Md Ibrahim for the New Gini Properties attack?
mcqs.explanation: Investigators say prime accused Shahriar Mahmud agreed to pay Ibrahim Tk 10 million (Tk 1 crore).

mcqs.question: After the announced pay rise, what is a Gram Police member's monthly salary?
mcqs.explanation: A member's salary rises from Tk 7,500 to Tk 10,500; a chief's rises from Tk 8,000 to Tk 11,000.

mcqs.question: How many Bangladeshis were killed in the road accident in Saudi Arabia on 7 November 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Seven Bangladeshis were killed and 15 injured when a truck rammed into their bus.

mcqs.question: Where did the attack on police during an Awami League procession take place?

options.B: Chattogram, Taltola under Bandar police station

mcqs.explanation: The incident took place in the Taltola area of Port Connecting Road, under Bandar police station in Chattogram.

mcqs.explanation: The ICT Division spent Tk 800 million developing 12 software tools; usage appears very limited.
